articleHelp.country.articleless: Country and region names like Deutschland, Finnland, Mexiko, and Europa are normally used without an article. When an article is required, they are neuter: das Deutschland der 1990er.
articleHelp.country.die: Some country names are used with a fixed article. Feminine examples take die: die Türkei, die Schweiz, die Ukraine.
articleHelp.plural_only.die: Plural-only noun (Pluralia tantum). It has no singular form and always uses die.
articleHelp.nominalized_infinitive: Morphological: nominalized infinitive -> always das. Any German verb can be used as a noun when capitalized: das Wiederhören, das Essen, das Schreiben.
articleHelp.standard_die_butter: Standard German uses die Butter. Der Butter is regional, so learners should memorize die Butter.
articleHelp.medical_field: Die Medizin is feminine, but this is not the female-person suffix -in. Memorize it as die Medizin.
articleHelp.neuter_country_region: Proper-name geography term: used without an article in most contexts; grammatically neuter when an article is needed.
articleHelp.compound_bahn: Compound noun: gender follows the final element Bahn (die). This is the key compound rule in German.
articleHelp.compound_mann: Compound noun: gender follows the final element Mann (der). The plural follows Mann -> Männer.
articleHelp.compound_tag: Compound noun: gender follows the final element Tag (der). Geburtstag therefore takes der.
articleHelp.gegen_not_ge: This is not the Ge- collective prefix pattern. Memorize the article with the noun.
articleHelp.young_animal: Das Junge means a young animal/offspring. It is neuter; do not confuse it with der Junge (boy).
articleHelp.abbreviation_loan: Abbreviation/loanword. The article is fixed by usage, so memorize it with the abbreviation.
articleHelp.cafe_loan: French loanword ending in stressed -é. Das Café is neuter; memorize it with its accent and article.

pluralHelp.country.none: Country and region names are normally singular only.
pluralHelp.plural_only.generic: Plural-only noun (Pluralia tantum): there is no singular form to learn.
pluralHelp.singular_only.items: Normally singular-only in this meaning; use a compound for individual items.
pluralHelp.rare_special_plural: The stored plural is correct but rare/specialized; the everyday meaning is usually singular.
pluralHelp.types_plural: This plural is mainly used for types, varieties, or separate traditions, not for the ordinary mass/abstract meaning.
pluralHelp.institution_plural: This plural is mainly used for separate institutions/forces or policy approaches, not for the broad abstract meaning.
pluralHelp.limited_marked_plural: This plural is limited or marked; learn the common singular meaning first.
pluralHelp.risiko: Main plural: die Risiken. The form Risikos also exists, but Risiken is the more useful learner form.
pluralHelp.konto: Irregular learned plural: das Konto -> die Konten. Memorize the full pair.
pluralHelp.stadion: Greek neuter -ion pattern: das Stadion -> die Stadien. Similar neuter Greek-origin nouns can have -ien plurals.
pluralHelp.mal: Plural die Male is used for marks/times as nouns. Counting expressions usually use lowercase mal: zweimal, drei Mal.
pluralHelp.geld: Die Gelder means funds/monies allocated from different sources. Geld as money in general is usually singular.
pluralHelp.unterricht: Die Unterrichte is uncommon. For individual lessons/classes, Unterrichtsstunden is usually more natural.
pluralHelp.sicht: Regular useful plural: die Sichten, especially for views/perspectives.
pluralHelp.handel: Trade/commerce is normally singular-only. Händel is a different word meaning quarrels.
pluralHelp.weiterbildung: Plural die Weiterbildungen is common for training courses/programs.
pluralHelp.pommes: Plural-only noun: die Pommes. There is no singular form.
pluralHelp.lkw: Plural: die Lkw or die Lkws. Both are used for the abbreviation.
pluralHelp.cd: Plural: die CDs. Abbreviations commonly add -s.
pluralHelp.email: Plural: die E-Mails. English-style loanwords commonly add -s.
pluralHelp.cafe: Plural: die Cafés. Loanwords ending in a stressed vowel commonly add -s.
pluralHelp.sbahn: Plural: die S-Bahnen, following Bahn -> Bahnen.
pluralHelp.hausmann: Plural follows Mann -> Männer: der Hausmann -> die Hausmänner.
pluralHelp.young_animal: Plural: die Jungen. This entry means offspring/young animals, not der Junge (boy).

Stadion.articleHelp: Greek-origin neuter -ion noun: das Stadion. This does not follow the Latin -tion/-sion feminine pattern.

Englisch.articleHelp: Language names are neuter when substantivized: das Englisch. In ordinary use they often appear without an article: Ich lerne Englisch.

E-Mail.articleHelp: English loanword compound. Die E-Mail follows die Mail and is the standard learner article.
